name: Rover
description: The mysterious Resonator who awakened on the shores of Solaris-3. Rover wields the power of Spectro and adapts to any team, able to resonate with Havoc and Aero frequencies as their journey unfolds.

skills.name: Resonating Slashes
skills.description: Basic Attack — Unleashes up to 4 consecutive sword strikes dealing Spectro DMG.

skills.name: Resonance Liberation: Echoing Wavelength
skills.description: Deals massive Spectro DMG in a wide arc and grants Rover Diminutive Sound stacks, boosting the next Resonance Skill.

skills.name: Cycle of Capture
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Fires a resonating wave that immobilizes Tacet Discords and restores Concerto Energy on hit.

name: Jiyan
description: General of the Midnight Rangers. Jiyan rides the wind itself, sweeping battlefields with vast Aero strikes and rallying allies with unbreakable resolve.

skills.name: Lone Lance: Soaring
skills.description: Basic Attack — Performs up to 5 heavy broadblade swings dealing Aero DMG.

skills.name: Emerald Storm: Unscathed
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Enters Qingloong Unscaled mode, empowering attacks with sweeping wind lances.

skills.name: Windqueller
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Summons a gale that pulls enemies together and deals Aero DMG over time.

name: Yinlin
description: Former Jinzhou Patroller turned shadow operative. Yinlin manipulates Electro puppets and punishment marks to punish enemies from afar.

skills.name: Zap String
skills.description: Basic Attack — Controls the puppet Blitz to lash enemies with up to 4 Electro strikes.

skills.name: Thundering Wrath
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Calls down chained lightning, detonating all Punishment Marks for burst Electro DMG.

skills.name: Magnetic Roar
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Deals Electro DMG and applies Punishment Mark, enabling coordinated off-field damage.

name: Jinhsi
description: Magistrate of Jinzhou and the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator. Jinhsi channels the luminous will of Jué, ascending the heavens to deliver righteous Spectro judgment.

skills.name: Palm of Radiance
skills.description: Basic Attack — Performs up to 4 graceful broadblade strikes dealing Spectro DMG.

skills.name: Purification of Light
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Soars skyward and crashes down with Incandescent Ordinance, scaling with Incandescence stacks.

skills.name: Trailing Lights
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Dashes forward in a beam of light, gaining Incandescence and dealing Spectro DMG.

name: Changli
description: Counselor to the Magistrate and master of flame strategy. Changli weaves fire and feathers together, trading blows in a blazing dance of sacrifice and rebirth.

skills.name: Blazing Enlightenment
skills.description: Basic Attack — Performs up to 4 swift sword strikes dealing Fusion DMG.

skills.name: Flaming Sacrifice
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Unleashes Tripartite Flames and enters Flaming Heart state, amplifying Fusion DMG.

skills.name: Obedience of Rules
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Summons a phoenix of flame that dives at enemies and grants Enflamement stacks.

name: Shorekeeper
description: Guardian of the Black Shores and keeper of the Tethys System. The Shorekeeper bends spacetime itself to shield allies, heal wounds, and amplify the whole team.

skills.name: Stellarealms
skills.description: Basic Attack — Conjures crystalline butterflies that deal Spectro DMG across up to 4 stages.

skills.name: Endless Collapse
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Expands the Stellarealm, healing allies over time and boosting Crit Rate and Crit DMG.

skills.name: Chaos Theory
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Deploys a dimensional field that collects butterflies, restores HP, and buffs team DMG.

name: Verina
description: Former botanist of the New Federation, now blooming in Jinzhou. Verina nurtures allies with photosynthesis-powered healing and earthen Spectro protection.

skills.name: Cultivation
skills.description: Basic Attack — Fires vine-infused shots dealing Spectro DMG across up to 5 stages.

skills.name: Bloom of Life
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Causes a grand blossom that heals all nearby allies and boosts all-attribute damage.

skills.name: Botanical Trial
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Plants a field of flowers that periodically heals the active Resonator.

name: Calcharo
description: Leader of the Ghost Hounds and exiled mercenary. Calcharo unleashes ruthless Electro combos, trading his own stillness for overwhelming phantom sword strikes.

skills.name: Extermination Order
skills.description: Basic Attack — Performs up to 4 brutal broadblade swings dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Phantom Etching
skills.description: Resonance Liberation — Enters Death Messenger state, converting attacks to rapid phantom Electro slashes.

skills.name: Hunting Mission
skills.description: Resonance Skill — Summons phantoms that strike together, dealing Electro DMG and generating Cruelty stacks.
